hotels.title: Adults-Only Vanuatu Beachfront Bliss with All-Inclusive Dining, Massages & Island Excursions
hotels.description: This beachfront boutique retreat invites you to reconnect with nature by the Pacific Ocean, where intimate scale meets spectacular surroundings. Home to just eight couples at a time, each traditionally designed room and villa delivers seclusion and serenity on beautiful Espiritu Santo - one of Vanuatu's most spectacular islands. The archipelago's brilliant blue waters sit just steps from the resort. A curated weekly schedule of guided island excursions are included in your stay, from exploring the ethereal blue waters of Santo's Blue Holes to visiting the local market alongside the chef or spending the afternoon on Champagne Beach's powdery white sands. Back at the property, the chef crafts breakfast, lunch and dinner using fresh ingredients sourced from local markets and nearby waters. Between meals, take out a kayak or paddleboard, grab snorkelling gear, or simply let the slow rhythm of island life take over. With traditional bungalow-style accommodation, personalised service and the untouched natural beauty of Espiritu Santo surrounding you, this is the intimate, unhurried Vanuatu you've been dreaming of.
